# George Barbu

> Canonical Knowledge Platform for the Person entity George Barbu.

## Entity summary

George Barbu is the founder of InfoWebPlus (founded 2016; Manilva, Spain) and a Frontend Platform Lead. He focuses on engineering leadership, software architecture, platform engineering, AI and business automation, technical strategy, and making people and work clear to cite. Location: Spain (EU Remote). Languages: Romanian (native), English (C1), Spanish (B2).
